theme: Published reverse and edge coverage of the Lothal elephant sealings
question: Which published contact views can distinguish the tentative box and jar-stopper interpretations for L-164 and selected controls?
outcome: Five frozen objects were audited. Three have registered non-obverse photographs in the selected sources; L-164 and L-167 do not. The ledger lists sixteen target photograph panels, many already held or previously inspected. Rao Figure 38B supplies two paired elephant drawings, including one probable L-164 candidate without a recovered number key. Original plates CLXI–CLXIV were located and inspected. A 100 by 115 pixel poster preview was acquired; no full new PDF or support-type resolution resulted.
challenge: Published halftones leave contact geometry uncertain; the original drawing lacks a recovered excavation-number binding; full poster and 2024 figure routes returned HTTP 403.
remedy: Bounded five-object protocol, explicit source and exposure ledger, native figure resolution checks, separate candidate drawings and registered photographs, and corrected inherited CISI printed-page metadata in version 2 manifests.
retry_when: A registered calibrated underside and continuous edge series for L-164 or L-167, a Figure 38B number key, or accessible full-resolution later author photographs becomes available. Existing obverses alone do not decide support geometry.
